note: Absolute floors ratchet quality. Since 2026-10-02 the measurement counts one-line and elif guards, which the compact kernels use for most rules; floors were raised to match the cases added that day. On 2026-10-03 every harness reached 0.85, so the default floor rose from 0.75 to 0.85 and the four skills that crossed it that day got their own floors. Held-guard counts remain the primary regression gate. On 2026-10-03 (later) every harness reached 0.93 after pinning exact error lists, boundary cases and non-object cases (raw_case); the default floor rose to 0.92 and every skill measured at 0.95 or above got a 0.95 floor.
